datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Burkina Faso in 2013. Geographic boundaries were classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity levels under different scenarios. Data was compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for January, April, July, and October 2013 projections.
